name: How do I choose the right design and finish for my coffered ceiling?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right design and finish for my coffered ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right design involves considering your room's existing architectural style, furniture, and overall aesthetic. Square patterns are classic, while rectangular or more intricate geometric designs can add a unique touch. For finishes, white or light colors make a room feel larger, while darker stains create a cozy, luxurious atmosphere. We recommend reviewing portfolios and considering samples during our consultation to help visualize the best fit for your home in Kuna or Star.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your room's style and existing elements; lighter finishes make rooms feel larger, while darker stains create a cozier feel.
